messages:
maria-g: FYI: incoming onboarding ticket from Bluefin Labs — they completed SSO/OIDC flow but don't see an API key in the console.
kevin-s: Can you paste the customer org ID and any audit events? I'll look up provisioning traces.
maria-g: Org: bluefin-labs (org_8f9c). Their support ticket shows: 'I finished SSO setup and console shows onboarding success but no API key visible'. They included an audit link.
kevin-s: Opening audit. provisioner-bot: [audit] 2026-03-17T15:04:12Z key.created key_id=ak_9b2f project=bluefin-dev created_by=provisioner-service tenant=org_8f9c claim_type=oidc
kevin-s: Huh — audit shows key created, but project is bluefin-dev not bluefin-prod. Did they expect prod project? marie-g: (typo) maria-g: they said expected project name = "bluefin" / production project created during onboarding was "bluefin-prod".
liz-support: Customer says they clicked the 'Create production project' checkbox during signup.
maria-g: Repro steps I ran locally against staging repro: 1) Complete OIDC handshake 2) provisioning service POST /provision with {claim: oidc, desired_project: "bluefin-prod"} 3) Provisioner created project bluefin-dev (race with org naming) 4) API key created and bound to bluefin-dev instead of bluefin-prod.
kevin-s: Probably a naming collision in the project allocator when short-names match. Can you share the event IDs? provisioner-bot: [trace] trace_id=tr_00321 allocate_project -> candidate_suffix="-dev" chosen_project="bluefin-dev" fallback=no
maria-g: Customer can confirm the key exists: audit line present, but console project filter hides it since they opened bluefin-prod. They reported 'No keys in project'.
liz-support: Quick fix for customer: either switch project in console to bluefin-dev and copy key, or we rebind key to bluefin-prod. Customer prefers rebind.
kevin-s: I can rebind. Steps: find key_id and patch its project_id.
kevin-s: Running safe rebind now: `PATCH /internal/provisioner/keys/ak_9b2f` body:
```
{
  "project_id": "proj_bluefin_prod_01",
  "reason": "customer onboarding mismatch - moved to prod per request",
  "performed_by": "kevin-s"
}
```
provisioner-bot: [task] rebind-request received for ak_9b2f by kevin-s
provisioner-bot: [task] rebind-complete key_id=ak_9b2f old_project=bluefin-dev new_project=bluefin-prod
kevin-s: Done. Please ask customer to refresh console and confirm.
maria-g: Messaging customer now: "We found the key bound to a sibling project (bluefin-dev). We've moved it to your production project; you should see it in the Console -> Projects -> bluefin-prod -> API Keys. If you don't see it, reply here and we'll rotate the key." :thumbsup:
liz-support: Customer replied: "I see it, thanks!" :tada:
maria-g: Notes for internal post-incident: root cause = project allocator selected wrong candidate when desired project name existed; safe rebind path worked. Action items: 1) Add extra validation step in provisioning when desired_project provided, ensure exact match or escalate to manual review. 2) Add UI hint to customers to check project selector when no keys appear. 3) Add metric to detect "key.created but not visible to expected project" events.
kevin-s: I'll open a dev ticket and assign to eng-infra. Ticket drafted: PROV-1428 "project allocator collision during OIDC onboarding - key bound to dev namespace"
maria-g: Closing loop with customer: suggest rotating key as best practice after rebind. Also leaving a note in the org audit: `note: rebind performed by support`.
liz-support: Adding tags: onboarding, api-keys, oidc, priority-low (customer recovered). :white_check_mark:
kevin-s: Will follow up with infra on the allocator fix. If anyone wants the exact trace lines DM me.
maria-g: Thanks all."
